mn111:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
mn111:3.1: idha bhikkhave, sāriputto vivicceva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
mn111:4.1: ye ca paṭhame jhāne dhammā vitakko ca vicāro ca pīti ca sukhañca cittekaggatā ca, phasso vedanā saññā cetanā cittaṃ chando adhimokkho viriyaṃ sati upekkhā manasikāro. tyāssa dhammā anupadavavatthitā honti.
mn111:4.2: tyāssa dhammā viditā uppajjanti, viditā upaṭṭhahanti, viditā abbhatthaṃ gacchanti.
mn111:4.4: evaṃ kira me dhammā ahutvā sambhonti, hutvā paṭiventī’ti.
mn111:4.5: so tesu dhammesu anupayo anapāyo anissito appaṭibaddho vippamutto visaṃyutto vimariyādīkatena cetasā viharati.
mn111:5.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave, sāriputto vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā ajjhattaṃ sampasādanaṃ cetaso ekodibhāvaṃ avitakkaṃ avicāraṃ samādhijaṃ pītisukhaṃ dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
mn111:6.1: ye ca dutiye jhāne dhammā ajjhattaṃ sampasādo ca pīti ca sukhañca cittekaggatā ca, phasso vedanā saññā cetanā cittaṃ chando adhimokkho viriyaṃ sati upekkhā manasikāro, tyāssa dhammā anupadavavatthitā honti.
mn111:6.2: tyāssa dhammā viditā uppajjanti, viditā upaṭṭhahanti, viditā abbhatthaṃ gacchanti.
mn111:6.4: ‘evaṃ kira me dhammā ahutvā sambhonti, hutvā paṭiventī’ti.
mn111:6.5: so tesu dhammesu anupayo anapāyo anissito appaṭibaddho vippamutto visaṃyutto vimariyādīkatena cetasā viharati.
mn111:7.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave, sāriputto pītiyā ca virāgā upekkhako ca viharati. sato ca sampajāno sukhañca kāyena paṭisaṃvedeti. yaṃ taṃ ariyā ācikkhanti: ‘upekkhako satimā sukhavihārī’ti taṃ tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
mn111:8.1: ye ca tatiye jhāne dhammā sukhañca sati ca sampajaññañca cittekaggatā ca, phasso vedanā saññā cetanā cittaṃ chando adhimokkho viriyaṃ sati upekkhā manasikāro.
mn111:8.2: tyāssa dhammā anupadavavatthitā honti. tyāssa dhammā viditā uppajjanti, viditā upaṭṭhahanti, viditā abbhatthaṃ gacchanti.
mn111:8.4: ‘evaṃ kira me dhammā ahutvā sambhonti, hutvā paṭiventī’ti.
mn111:8.5: so tesu dhammesu anupayo anapāyo anissito appaṭibaddho vippamutto visaṃyutto vimariyādīkatena cetasā viharati.
mn111:9.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave, sāriputto sukhassa ca pahānā dukkhassa ca pahānā pubbeva somanassadomanassānaṃ atthaṅgamā adukkhaṃ asukhaṃ upekkhāsatipārisuddhiṃ catutthaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
mn111:10.1: ye ca catutthe jhāne dhammā upekkhā adukkhamasukhā vedanā passaddhattā cetaso anābhogo satipārisuddhi cittekaggatā ca, phasso vedanā saññā cetanā cittaṃ chando adhimokkho viriyaṃ sati upekkhā manasikāro. tyāssa dhammā anupadavavatthitā honti.
mn111:10.2: tyāssa dhammā viditā uppajjanti, viditā upaṭṭhahanti, viditā abbhatthaṃ gacchanti.
mn111:10.4: ‘evaṃ kira me dhammā ahutvā sambhonti, hutvā paṭiventī’ti.
mn111:10.5: so tesu dhammesu anupayo anapāyo anissito appaṭibaddho vippamutto visaṃyutto vimariyādīkatena cetasā viharati.
mn111:11.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave, sāriputto sabbaso rūpasaññānaṃ samatikkamā paṭighasaññānaṃ atthaṅgamā nānattasaññānaṃ amanasikārā ‘ananto ākāso’ti ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati.
mn111:12.1: ye ca ākāsānañcāyatane dhammā ākāsānañcāyatanasaññā ca cittekaggatā ca phasso vedanā saññā cetanā cittaṃ chando adhimokkho viriyaṃ sati upekkhā manasikāro, tyāssa dhammā anupadavavatthitā honti.
mn111:12.2: tyāssa dhammā viditā uppajjanti, viditā upaṭṭhahanti, viditā abbhatthaṃ gacchanti.
mn111:12.4: ‘evaṃ kira me dhammā ahutvā sambhonti, hutvā paṭiventī’ti.
mn111:12.5: so tesu dhammesu anupayo anapāyo anissito appaṭibaddho vippamutto visaṃyutto vimariyādīkatena cetasā viharati.
mn111:13.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave, sāriputto sabbaso ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ samatikkamma ‘anantaṃ viññāṇa’nti viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati.
mn111:14.1: ye ca viññāṇañcāyatane dhammā viññāṇañcāyatanasaññā ca cittekaggatā ca, phasso vedanā saññā cetanā cittaṃ chando adhimokkho viriyaṃ sati upekkhā manasikāro, tyāssa dhammā anupadavavatthitā honti.
mn111:14.2: tyāssa dhammā viditā uppajjanti, viditā upaṭṭhahanti, viditā abbhatthaṃ gacchanti.
mn111:14.4: ‘evaṃ kira me dhammā ahutvā sambhonti, hutvā paṭiventī’ti.
mn111:14.5: so tesu dhammesu anupayo anapāyo anissito appaṭibaddho vippamutto visaṃyutto vimariyādīkatena cetasā viharati.
mn111:15.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave, sāriputto sabbaso viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ samatikkamma ‘natthi kiñci’ti ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati.
mn111:16.1: ye ca ākiñcaññāyatane dhammā ākiñcaññāyatanasaññā ca cittekaggatā ca, phasso vedanā saññā cetanā cittaṃ chando adhimokkho viriyaṃ sati upekkhā manasikāro, tyāssa dhammā anupadavavatthitā honti.
mn111:16.2: tyāssa dhammā viditā uppajjanti, viditā upaṭṭhahanti, viditā abbhatthaṃ gacchanti.
mn111:16.4: ‘evaṃ kira me dhammā ahutvā sambhonti, hutvā paṭiventī’ti.
mn111:16.5: so tesu dhammesu anupayo anapāyo anissito appaṭibaddho vippamutto visaṃyutto vimariyādīkatena cetasā viharati.
mn111:17.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave, sāriputto sabbaso ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ samatikkamma nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati.
mn111:18.2: so tāya samāpattiyā sato vuṭṭhahitvā ye te dhammā atītā niruddhā vipariṇatā, te dhamme samanupassati:
mn111:18.3: ‘evaṃ kira me dhammā ahutvā sambhonti, hutvā paṭiventī’ti.
mn111:18.4: so tesu dhammesu anupayo anapāyo anissito appaṭibaddho vippamutto visaṃyutto vimariyādīkatena cetasā viharati.
mn111:19.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave, sāriputto sabbaso nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ samatikkamma saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ upasampajja viharati. paññāya cassa disvā āsavā parikkhīṇā honti.
mn111:20.2: so tāya samāpattiyā sato vuṭṭhahitvā ye te dhammā atītā niruddhā vipariṇatā, te dhamme samanupassati:
mn111:20.3: evaṃ kira me dhammā ahutvā sambhonti, hutvā paṭiventī’ti.
mn111:20.4: so tesu dhammesu anupayo anapāyo anissito appaṭibaddho vippamutto visaṃyutto vimariyādīkatena cetasā viharati.
mn111:21.1: yaṃ kho taṃ bhikkhave, sammā vadamāno vadeyya:
mn111:21.2: vasippatto pāramippatto ariyasmiṃ sīlasmiṃ, vasippatto pāramippatto ariyasmiṃ samādhismiṃ, vasippatto pāramippatto ariyāya paññāya, vasippatto pāramippatto ariyāya vimuttiyāti. sāriputtameva taṃ sammā vadamāno vadeyya
mn111:21.3: vasippatto pāramippatto ariyasmiṃ sīlasmiṃ, vasippatto pāramippatto ariyasmiṃ samādhismiṃ, vasippatto pāramippatto ariyāya paññāya, vasippatto pāramippatto ariyāya vimuttiyā’ti.
mn111:22.1: yaṃ kho taṃ bhikkhave, sammā vadamāno vadeyya:
mn111:22.2: ‘bhagavato putto oraso mukhato jāto dhammajo dhammanimmito dhammadāyādo no āmisadāyādo’ti. sāriputtameva taṃ sammā vadamāno vadeyya
mn111:22.3: bhagavato putto oraso mukhato jāto dhammajo dhammanimmito dhammadāyādo no āmisadāyādo’ti.
mn111:23.1: sāriputto bhikkhave, tathāgatena anuttaraṃ dhammacakkaṃ pavattitaṃ sammadeva anuppavattetīti.
mn111:23.3: attamanā te bhikkhū bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandunti.
